stories.headline: Opposition party organiser killed before South Africa elections
stories.description: Police are investigating the motive in murder of MKP coordinator as political killings rise during municipal elections.

stories.headline: Ukraine’s Zelenskyy hopes Abu Dhabi talks will open path to Putin meeting
stories.description: Ukrainian president meets German chancellor in Berlin, who says Russia is yet to engage seriously in peace efforts.

stories.headline: When will we know who won the US midterms?
stories.description: Once polls close, it is possible the results will not be projected for several hours, days or even weeks

stories.headline: Syria says it foiled Hezbollah plot to target Homs oil refinery
stories.description: Hezbollah denies the Syrian accusations, reiterating that it does not have any presence on Syrian territory.

stories.headline: Israel’s opposition leaders back Eisenkot to oust Netanyahu
stories.description: Opposition promises to form a government quickly but remains split over whether to ally with Arab-led parties.
